title: Local Lyapunov Exponent-Guided Stochastic Midcourse Correction Design of Low-Energy Earth-Moon Transfers
summary: Midcourse correction is essential for reliable cislunar transfer missions. For low-energy Earth-Moon transfers, strongly nonuniform error growth makes conventional correction strategies less effective. This paper proposes a stochastic midcourse correction design for low-energy Earth-Moon transfers based on local Lyapunov exponent (LLE). The local error-amplification characteristics of the nominal trajectory are first analyzed using an instantaneous LLE.
